limitations: This acceptance completes the stated original identity-isolation requirement. It does not add a new cache implementation or demonstrate semantic-model quality, ranking improvements, production latency or LegacyValidation task benefit.

The public check uses three sequential processes and a local two-dimensional model oracle. It does not prove simultaneous distinct public configurations in one process; the retained actual-engine native check supplies that service-level evidence. Concurrent churn is not a barrier-controlled race proof.

No new Cargo invocation, native/full-suite replay, real provider/model call, actual LegacyValidation source/Q/index mutation or normal configuration change. Independent original resource, hosted verification and task-usefulness requirements remain open.
